## About me

I’m Brijeshkumar, a full stack engineer based in India. I build products where every detail matters.

In 2020, when schools closed during COVID, I started learning to code through YouTube.

I didn’t have a roadmap, a bootcamp, or a clear plan for my future. I just kept learning, building things, making mistakes, and improving little by little.

In 2021, before finishing school, I got my first job as a Frontend Engineer.

What started as a way to spend my time became the beginning of my career.

Now, I’m still learning, building, and exploring.
